scripts.db:count: docker compose exec postgres psql -U nestsms -d audit_dev -c 'select count(*) from audit_logs;'
scripts.demo:reset: docker compose exec redis redis-cli flushall && docker compose exec postgres psql -U nestsms -d audit_dev -c 'TRUNCATE audit_logs;'
scripts.db:latest: docker compose exec postgres psql -U nestsms -d audit_dev -c 'select action, "userId", "ipAddress", "createdAt" from audit_logs order by "createdAt" desc limit 10;'
